BREAKFAST 05
Crunchy Honey Granola
A golden stash for many mornings.
TIME
30 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Easy
SERVES
6 portions
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT LIKE THIS
150 g of rolled oats
60 g of almonds or hazelnuts
30 g of mixed seeds
2 tablespoons of Millefiori honey
1 tablespoon of seed oil
01 Mix all the ingredients.
02 Spread on a baking sheet and bake at 160 °C
for 20-25 minutes.
03 Turn halfway through cooking and let
cool completely.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Millefiori
Round and versatile: it evenly distributes sweetness
and aroma.

STORE AND PORTION
01 Jar
Clean and tightly sealed, away from heat and
humidity.

MY IDEAS
THE DECISIVE STEP · Seal it in the jar

BREAKFAST 06
Mixed Fruit Salad with Peach Honey
Colors, freshness, and a scent of summer.
TIME
10 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very Easy
SERVES
2 people
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
300 g of mixed fresh fruit
1 teaspoon of lemon juice
1-2 teaspoons of Peach Honey
01 Wash and chop the fruit into pieces.
02 Add a few drops of lemon and mix.
03 Finish with the honey just before serving.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Peach Honey
Soft and fruity: it complements the fruit without weighing it down.

BREAKFAST 07
Apple, cinnamon and honey toast
Smells like apple pie, ready in minutes.
TIME
7 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
2 slices of bread
1/2 apple
Cinnamon to taste
1 teaspoon of Acacia honey
01 Toast the bread until crisp.
02 Arrange thin apple slices on top.
03 Finish with cinnamon and honey.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Acacia
Fine and light: it complements apple and cinnamon with subtlety.

more indulgent

SERVE IT ON THE TABLE

slightly.
MY TOUCH

BREAKFAST 08
Banana and Honey Smoothie
Creamy and quick, even on rushed mornings.
TIME
5 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
1 banana
150 g yogurt or 180 ml milk
3 ice cubes
1 teaspoon Millefiori honey
01 Put all the ingredients in the
blender.
02 Blend until creamy.
03 Taste and add honey only if
needed.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Millefiori
Balanced and fragrant: it complements the banana
without overpowering it.

The smoothie
formula
THE FORMULA
01 Five elements
1 fruit + 1 creamy base + 1 liquid + honey
+ 1 extra.
FOUR COMBINATIONS
01 Banana and cocoa
Yogurt, milk, Millefiori honey and cocoa.
02 Banana and oats
Yogurt, milk, Acacia honey and oats.
03 Strawberry and yogurt
Milk and Strawberry honey.
04 Peach and milk
Yogurt and Peach honey.
MY FORMULA
CONSISTENCY · Less liquid to make it thick;
add milk one spoonful at a time to
lighten it up.

BREAKFAST 09
Cold strawberry porridge
Prepare it the night before and it's ready in the morning.
TIME
5 min + rest
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
40 g rolled oats
120 g yogurt
60 ml milk
5 strawberries
1 teaspoon Strawberry Honey
01 In the evening, mix oats, yogurt, and
milk in a jar.
02 Close and let it rest in the refrigerator.
03 In the morning, add strawberries and honey.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Strawberry Honey
Sweet and fruity: enhances the fresh part of
the jar.
